questions.q: What setting does a Text field require at creation that determines how many characters it can hold?
options: Restrict picklist to the values defined in the value set
questions.explain: A Text field's Length setting caps its maximum character count, enforced on every record going forward.

questions.q: What two settings does a Number field ask for at creation?
questions.explain: A Number field asks for Length (digits before the decimal) and Decimal Places (digits after it).

questions.q: How is Currency different from a plain Number field, per this lesson?
options: Currency cannot store decimals at all
Currency formats the value with a currency symbol and can respect per-record currency in multi-currency orgs
Currency is only available on custom objects
questions.explain: Currency is a close cousin of Number with the same decimal-place setting, but it adds currency-symbol formatting and multi-currency awareness.

questions.q: What settings does a Checkbox field require beyond choosing the type?
options: Length and Decimal Places, same as Number
A list of values, same as Picklist
None — Checkbox is a simple True/False value with no length or precision to configure
questions.explain: Checkbox is the simplest field type: a single True/False value with no additional settings.

questions.q: On the real Property record shown in this lesson, which data type holds the Listed On value?
questions.explain: Listed On is a Date field, shown alongside Property Name (Text), Bedrooms/Square Footage (Number), and Price (Currency) on the same record.
